_comment: SEER (Relationalseo) export shape for Authority Radar. Provide any mix of OS-tool scores, direct category scores, and individual classifier scores (0-100). Everything is rolled up into the 12 authority signals and the Authority Index. `weights` optionally recalibrates the index (category ids; renormalized to sum 100). See lib/authority/seer-taxonomy.js for the full 9 tools / 12 categories / 205 classifiers.
